description: Implementation of the WindowManager class for HTTP/2 window size management, including window update logic and listener notifications.

classes.name: WindowManager
classes.description: Manages HTTP/2 flow control window size, updates, and listener notifications.

methods.name: DefaultShouldWindowUpdateFn
methods.description: Determines if a window update should be sent based on current limits and delta.

methods.name: WindowManager::OnWindowSizeLimitChange
methods.description: Handles changes to the window size limit.

methods.name: WindowManager::SetWindowSizeLimit
methods.description: Sets a new window size limit and potentially notifies the listener.

methods.name: WindowManager::MarkDataBuffered
methods.description: Marks data as buffered and possibly triggers a window update.

methods.name: WindowManager::MarkDataFlushed
methods.description: Marks data as flushed and potentially triggers a window update.

methods.name: WindowManager::MaybeNotifyListener
methods.description: Checks if a window update is needed and notifies the listener.
